extracted.intended_audience: authors/researchers preparing and submitting papers to arXiv
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and requirements for preparing and submitting a paper (text + figures + metadata) to the arXiv preprint server, including acceptable file formats, metadata, submission timing, and replacement policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitter must be a registered author
rubrics_metrics.description: We accept submissions only from registered authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must register with arXiv and submit under their own account; third-party submissions (e.g., by secretaries) are discouraged because they often cause problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: License to distribute or equivalent
rubrics_metrics.description: Submitters must grant arXiv.org a non-exclusive and irrevocable license to distribute or certify that the work is available under another license that conveys these rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must either grant arXiv the stated distribution license or assert an alternate license that provides the same distribution rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: No omitted figures, tables, sections or 'abstract only' submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv does not accept submissions with omitted figures, tables or sections. We also do not accept 'abstract only' submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions missing substantive content are unhelpful to readers and have limited archival value. Do not omit core components even if you provide links to external servers.

rubrics_metrics.name: File name character restrictions and case sensitivity
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv will only accept the following characters in file names: a-z A-Z 0-9 _ + - . , =. The presence of any other character will cause the system to reject the entire submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid spaces, question marks, asterisks, etc. File names and extensions are case sensitive on the arXiv system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted text submission formats (order of preference)
rubrics_metrics.description: Your submission must be in one of the following formats (listed in order of preference): (La)TeX, AMS(La)TeX, PDFLaTeX; DOCX (Word 2007); PDF; PostScript; HTML with JPEG/PNG/GIF images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: arXiv's goal is to store highly portable, stable formats. TeX/LaTeX is currently the best choice because it does not hide information. Note that arXiv will not accept dvi, PS, or PDF created from TeX/LaTeX source. Users of older word processors should save as PDF. Scanned documents are not accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not submit scanned documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Scanned documents are not accepted, regardless of format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generate submission files directly from source (LaTeX/Word/PDF generators) rather than uploading scanned images of pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figure file formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Figures can be in PostScript (PS/EPS), JPEG, GIF, PNG, or PDF (PDF figures only with PDFLaTeX).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PS/EPS for line drawings/plots, JPEG for photographic images, GIF/PNG for non-photographic bitmaps. If figures are submitted with LaTeX source, use standard macro packages (graphics, graphicx) so they appear in the document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce figure file sizes for accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: If figure files are too large, readers with poor network connections will not be able to download them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make all possible efforts to reduce figure sizes (optimize images, avoid unnecessarily large bitmaps). See arXiv's information on submission sizes and bitmapping help. If you have problems with a large submission, contact www-admin@arXiv.org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not omit figures even if linked externally
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv does not accept submissions with omitted figures, even if you provide a link to another server.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All essential figures must be included in the submission package to ensure archival completeness and accessibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: arXiv will not provide TeX troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv administration cannot provide help with TeX-related issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek help from colleagues or community resources for TeX problems; ensure your LaTeX source and figure macros are standard so arXiv can build the document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read arXiv response and verify abstract and formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: After you submit your paper, you will receive a response from arXiv; it is very important that you read this response and check for errors in the copy of the abstract that appears in the message.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The response to a successful submission will include a URL to view the PostScript version generated by arXiv and a username/password for viewing it. If you see errors or are unhappy with formatting, replace the paper or contact www-admin@arXiv.org before 16:00 US Eastern time explaining the problem (include archive and paper number) but do not send files to that address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement policy for corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: If you replace before 16:00 US Eastern time Monday through Friday, the archive software will not generate an additional date stamp.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are encouraged to update and correct papers by replacing the original submission rather than making a new submission for a corrected paper or an erratum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authors must submit personally / take responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors must make their own submissions because putting papers on the archives entails certain responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Third-party submissions often cause the most problems; submit under the author's own arXiv account whenever possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required metadata: institutional affiliation and report numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutional affiliation for the author(s) must be provided. Official report number(s) from the author(s) institution(s) must be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include complete affiliation metadata and any institutional report numbers when prompted in the submission form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission availability schedule and daily timing rules
rubrics_metrics.description: All archives are on a daily availability schedule, with no activity scheduled on weekends. Each day's submissions are not made available to the general public until 20:00 US Eastern time Sunday through Thursday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example rules: a Monday submission before 16:00 Eastern will be available after 20:00 Monday and appear in Tuesday AM mailing; a Friday submission before 16:00 will be available after 20:00 Sunday and appear in Monday AM mailing; a Friday submission after 16:00 will be available after 20:00 Monday and appear in Tuesday AM mailing. Check current local time at main site for exact cutoffs.
